CALL 4 · MONDAY, OCTOBER 26 · THE CLIENT ENGINE
The 30-minute weekly outreach system, built on screen with your targets. Three plays Round One never had: the 10-minute brokerage presentation, the expired-listing play, and the referral ask that turns four agents into nine.
Watch first: replays 07 and 08.
Bring: a list of 20 agents in your market you'd want to work with.
Hot seats: [member], [member], Jackie, [member].
Leave with: your engine sheet loaded and the office presentation template.

CALL 5 · MONDAY, NOVEMBER 2 · THE 10 FRAMES
What actually sells a luxury listing: which ten frames, six composition rules, gallery order, and how few to deliver. A pre-filmed segment from a real estate shoot, then your galleries critiqued against the standard.
Watch first: replays 03 and 11.
Bring: one recent gallery, your best one.
Hot seats: Victor, [member], [member], [member], [member], [member].
Leave with: the 10-frame shot list and one reshoot assignment.

CALL 6 · MONDAY, NOVEMBER 9 · PROPOSALS THAT CLOSE
Anatomy of a real $15,450 proposal, clause by clause. A proposal built live from a member's real inquiry. Then the retainer pitch as a meeting, not a model: [member] pitches, [member] plays the agent.
Watch first: replays 13 and 05.
Bring: one real inquiry or job you're quoting right now.
Hot seats: [member], [member], [member], [member].
Leave with: the proposal template and the pitch script.

CALL 7 · MONDAY, NOVEMBER 16 · BUILD IT LIVE
Booking form, board, confirmation, day sheet, and delivery email, built alongside me in 45 minutes with the Systems Kit open. Then the layer Round One never covered: your first shooter, the SOP, the QC checklist, and pay.
Watch first: replay 15, and download the Systems Kit attached to it.
Bring: your laptop and whatever your booking process is today.
Hot seats: [member], [member], Victor, [member], Jackie, [member].
Leave with: a working booking form and board, plus a shooter SOP.

NO CALL MONDAY, NOVEMBER 23. Thanksgiving week.

CALL 8 · MONDAY, NOVEMBER 30 · VIDEO THAT GETS YOU REHIRED + THE SCOREBOARD
Victor co-teaches directing agents who hate being on camera. The three vertical formats agents pay for and what to charge for each. Then the 60-day scoreboard: October 5 versus November 30, wins on record, and your next 90 days.
Bring: your wins and your updated numbers.
Hot seats: Jackie and [member] first, then everyone for the scoreboard.
Leave with: the agent-reel formula and your next-90 plan.

Topics are subject to change. If the room needs something different by week three, we change it. The dates and the time hold unless I say otherwise in here.

All eight are on the Skool calendar (Calendar tab). Add them to yours now.

Founders, you're on every one of these. Same scoreboard.

Jacob

title: Cohort Two Launch Checklist post (draft)
text:
Cohort Two Launch Checklist post (draft)

TITLE: Start Here: the Launch Checklist (your first assignment, due Sunday)

This is the first assignment, and it's the one post I want you coming back to for the next 60 days. Part one is due before the kickoff on Monday. Part two gets one line added after every call.

Part one takes about 30 minutes. It's the exact stuff I'm putting on screen at 10 AM Monday, so if you skip it you're the one person in the room without numbers.

PART ONE: BEFORE MONDAY, OCTOBER 5

1. Introduce yourself under Introductions if you haven't yet. Where you shoot, how long you've been at it, what you want out of the next 60 days.

2. Pull your last 90 days (July 1 to September 30). Three numbers:
Total revenue collected
Number of shoots
Hours a week you put into the business. All of it: shooting, driving, editing, emails, invoicing, social. Be honest, nobody's grading you.

3. Grab your current price sheet. A link or a screenshot. If you don't have one, write down what you quoted the last agent who asked.

4. List your top three clients by revenue and roughly what share of the 90 days they were.

5. Your website and Instagram links.

6. The number you want on the scoreboard by November 30. Gut answer. We pressure-test it live on the 5th.

7. Post all of it in the comments here. Copy this and fill it in:

Last 90 days revenue: $
Shoots:
Hours a week:
Price sheet:
Top 3 clients:
Website / IG:
November 30 number:

If you'd rather not put revenue in public, post everything else and DM me the revenue. But post something, because the audit runs off this.

8. Add all eight calls to your calendar. They're on the Skool calendar (Calendar tab up top). Monday, October 5 at 10 AM Pacific is first. Call two is FRIDAY, October 9, same time.

9. Show up on a laptop, camera on, 10 AM sharp. It's 90 minutes and you'll be on screen for four of them.

PART TWO: THE 60 DAYS

One line per call. After each one, come back and drop your line in a comment. This is the whole program in eight boxes, and on November 30 we read the list out loud.
